info.title: Campbooks API
info.description: The Campbooks HTTP API. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`. Operations require an OAuth 2.1 bearer token with the scope they list (401 without a valid token, 403 without the scope) unless they are public. The `/bff/*` operations serve the web app only: they authenticate with its session cookie instead of a token.

200.description: The instance and its database are up.

get.summary: Read from the API as the signed-in user.
get.description:
`/bff/api/<path>` is `/api/<path>` (same method, query, headers and
 body) with the session's access token attached, refreshed first when
 it is about to expire. The token never leaves the server. Answers are
 the API's own; without a live session the answer is 401
 `session_required` (sign in at `/bff/login`). POST, PUT, PATCH and
 DELETE need the `X-Campbooks-CSRF: 1` header from the app's origin.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The API path after `/api/`, e.g. `v1/system/version`; may contain slashes.

200.description: The API's response, whatever its status.

503.description: `bff_not_configured`, or the identity provider is unavailable while the access token needs refreshing.

post.description:
Called by the identity provider, not browsers, when a user's IdP session
ends: ends the web sessions the signed logout token names (by IdP session
id, or every session of the user).

200.description: The sessions named by the token are ended.

503.description: `bff_not_configured`, or the identity provider's keys are unavailable.

get.description:
The identity provider redirects here. Checks that `state` names a sign-in
this browser started (single use), exchanges the code with the PKCE
verifier, validates the ID token (issuer, audience, nonce, expiry,
signature), starts a session and sets the `SameSite=Strict` session
cookie. Answers with a small same-origin page that moves on to
`return_to`: a browser treats the whole redirect chain from the IdP as
cross-site and would not send the new cookie on a plain redirect.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The `state` sent with the authorization request.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: An error code instead of a code.

200.description: Signed in; the page moves on to `return_to`.

503.description: `bff_not_configured`, or the identity provider is unreachable.

get.description:
Creates a short-lived sign-in (state, nonce, PKCE verifier) bound to this
browser by a `SameSite=Lax` login cookie, and redirects to the identity
provider's authorization endpoint.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: Where to land after signing in: a path on this site (default `/`).

503.description: `bff_not_configured`, or the identity provider is unreachable.

post.description:
Ends the session, revokes its refresh token at the identity provider and
clears the cookie. Navigate to `logout_url` to end the identity
provider's session too.

200.description: Signed out (also when there was no session).

get.description:
For the web app to bootstrap: whether someone is signed in, and who.
Never returns a token.

logout_token.description: The identity provider's signed logout token.

database.description: Database status; always `ok` in a 200 response.

status.description: Overall status; always `ok` in a 200 response.

LogoutResponse.description: Where to send the browser to sign out of the identity provider too.

logout_url.description:
The identity provider's end-session URL (RP-initiated logout), which
comes back to the app's root; `null` when it has none.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

type.description:
URI identifying the problem type; `about:blank` when the HTTP status
says it all.

SessionInfo.description: Who is signed in. Never contains a token.

authenticated.description: Whether the request carries a live session.

expires_at.description: When the session ends at the latest (it ends sooner if left unused).

SessionUser.description: The signed-in user, as the identity provider describes them.

sub.description: Stable user id at the identity provider.

commit.description: Git commit the build came from, when known (`GIT_SHA` at runtime).

bearer.description:
An OAuth 2.1 access token (a JWT) issued by this instance's identity provider, the issuer configured as `CAMPBOOKS_AUTH__ISSUER`. Each operation lists the scope it requires; operations with an empty requirement are public. Scopes:

- `system:read`: Read operational status.

session.name: __Host-campbooks_session
session.description: The web app's session cookie, set by `/bff/callback` (`HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`; named `campbooks_session` when the instance's public URL is plain http). Unsafe methods also need the `X-Campbooks-CSRF: 1` header and a same-origin request.

tags.name: bff
tags.description: The web app's backend-for-frontend: sign-in, the session cookie and same-origin API access. Browsers only; other clients call `/api/*` with their own OAuth token.
